name: antigravity-for-claude-code
description: Delegate the reading to Gemini on Vertex AI through a local MCP server, keep the judgement on Claude: codebase digests, read-only tasks, second-model review, recordings and documents — the files never enter Claude's context.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Claude conducts; a long-context model reads. digest_codebase, delegate_task, review_diff and digest return file:line digests under a token budget; model choice lives in an organisation-controlled alias table and requests leave the machine only to allowlisted hosts (Vertex AI by default).
